description: M5 top-level inventory of every file and directory directly under astrid/. Classifications align with astrid/structure.py constants TOP_LEVEL_ASTRID_FILES and TOP_LEVEL_ASTRID_DIRS. Updated post M4 giant-file split to reflect gateway and SDK decomposition. This is a documentation artifact — not a runtime input.

classification_categories.public_facade: Part of the public SDK contract (directly or via lazy facade).
classification_categories.stable_compatibility_shim: Intentional backward-compatibility shim, not stale migration debt.
classification_categories.internal_kernel: Framework machinery under astrid/core — not public contract.
classification_categories.shared_library: Shared library/utility, not part of public SDK but used across subsystems.
classification_categories.planned_absent: Canonical concept allowed by constants but not materialized on disk.
classification_categories.generated_ignored: Build artifact or runtime cache — ignored by structure enforcement.
classification_categories.soft_boundary_convention: Convention documented for awareness, not hard-gated.
classification_categories.pack_machinery_shim: M2 shim — canonical implementation lives in astrid/core/pack/. This file exists only for backward-compatible imports and patch targets.
classification_categories.skill_only_shell: Directory under packs/ that contains only skill/SKILL.md — no pack.yaml, no capabilities. Not a runtime pack.
classification_categories.pack_compatibility_shell: Hidden pack under packs/ that preserves backward-compatible pack-level aliases and test infrastructure. Not a capability-producing pack.
classification_categories.gateway_split_module: M4 split module from giant-file decomposition of gateway.py. Internal implementation detail, not public contract.
classification_categories.sdk_split_module: M4 split module from giant-file decomposition of sdk.py. Internal implementation detail; sdk.py is the public aggregation facade.

top_level_files.name: __init__.py
top_level_files.notes: Lazy-loads 27 names from astrid/sdk.py via __getattr__. The normative v1 contract is docs/platform-contract.md.

top_level_files.name: _paths.py
top_level_files.notes: Backward-compatibility shim for astrid._paths. Star-re-exports from astrid.paths plus explicit re-exports. Listed in _STABLE_COMPATIBILITY_SHIM_EXEMPTIONS with TODO(m13) removal target.

top_level_files.notes: M4 split module: focused dispatch-table and parser helpers for the Astrid gateway (578 lines). Internal implementation detail — not public contract.

top_level_files.name: gateway_help.py
top_level_files.notes: M4 split module: help text and usage banners for the Astrid gateway (139 lines). Internal implementation detail — not public contract.

top_level_files.name: gateway_project.py
top_level_files.notes: M4 split module: project subcommand dispatch and handler for the Astrid gateway (155 lines). Internal implementation detail — not public contract.

top_level_files.name: gateway_wait.py
top_level_files.notes: M4 split module: wait/lease management and polling logic for the Astrid gateway (115 lines). Internal implementation detail — not public contract.

top_level_files.name: media.py
top_level_files.notes: Canonical media module. _media.py shims to this.

top_level_files.name: paths.py
top_level_files.notes: Repository and workspace path resolution. _paths.py shims to this.

top_level_files.name: pipeline.py
top_level_files.notes: Permanent backward-compatibility shim (SD1) — astrid.pipeline is astrid.gateway. Uses sys.modules[__name__] = sys.modules['astrid.gateway'] to alias itself. Listed in both _STABLE_COMPATIBILITY_SHIM_EXEMPTIONS and _SYS_MODULES_INJECTION_EXEMPTIONS. Zero internal callers; retained permanently.

top_level_files.name: sdk.py

Giant-file split completed in M4: implementation split across sdk_discovery.py (620), sdk_errors.py (148), sdk_generation.py (330), sdk_invocation.py (323), sdk_results.py (213).

top_level_files.name: sdk_discovery.py
top_level_files.notes: M4 split module: registry loading, discovery metadata, and capability resolution helpers (620 lines). Internal implementation detail — sdk.py is the public aggregation facade.

top_level_files.name: sdk_errors.py
top_level_files.notes: M4 split module: SDK exception taxonomy and error serialization (148 lines). Internal implementation detail — sdk.py is the public aggregation facade.

top_level_files.name: sdk_generation.py

top_level_files.name: sdk_invocation.py
top_level_files.notes: M4 split module: capability invocation pipeline and result handling (323 lines). Internal implementation detail — sdk.py is the public aggregation facade.

top_level_files.name: sdk_results.py

top_level_files.name: setup_cli.py
top_level_files.notes: Setup CLI support.

top_level_files.name: structure.py
top_level_files.notes: Single source of truth for repository structure enforcement. Exposes validate_repo_structure(), validate_import_layering(), validate_migration_completion(). Contains all exemption lists and the authoritative TOP_LEVEL_ASTRID_FILES / TOP_LEVEL_ASTRID_DIRS constants.

top_level_files.name: theme_schema.py
top_level_files.notes: Theme schema validation helpers. Soft boundary — convention.

top_level_directories.name: __pycache__
top_level_directories.notes: CPython bytecode cache. Ignored by structure enforcement.

top_level_directories.name: audit
top_level_directories.notes: Run-local provenance ledger, graph, transport, and HTML report. Contains __main__.py, cli.py, context.py, graph.py, report.py, transport.py, util.py.

top_level_directories.name: contracts
top_level_directories.notes: Common schema dataclasses: ports, outputs, cache, commands, isolation, errors, run status, capability schema, event hash, result manifest.

top_level_directories.name: core
top_level_directories.notes: Internal kernel — framework machinery. Contains adapter, element, executor, generation, lineage, model_catalog, orchestrator, pack (canonical pack machinery: discovery, resolver, store, manifest, override, alias_resolver, validate, CLI, install, entrypoint, agent_index, gitignore, schemas/), project, reigh, runpod, runtime, session, task, timeline, util, worker subdirectories. Also contains pack_machinery/ (thin compatibility shims, retained for M5) and loose pack_*.py / manifest.py / override.py / alias_resolver.py files (all thin re-export shims pointing into astrid/core/pack/). Anti-coupling rules enforced: core must not import from packs, orchestrate, or audit (with named exemptions). New internal code belongs under astrid/core/*; new pack machinery belongs under astrid/core/pack/*.

top_level_directories.name: docs
top_level_directories.notes: Package-level documentation within the astrid package. Contains generation/ subdirectory with feature and contract docs.

top_level_directories.name: domains
top_level_directories.notes: Domain-specific shared logic. Currently contains domains/hype/ for arrangement rules, enriched arrangements, and text matching.

top_level_directories.name: elements
top_level_directories.notes: Planned-but-not-materialized canonical concept. TOP_LEVEL_ASTRID_DIRS includes 'elements' but no astrid/elements/ directory exists on disk. M5 does not create it. Source-layout smoke tests treat elements/ as the only allowed planned-absent canonical directory.

top_level_directories.name: modalities
top_level_directories.notes: Modality-specific support code: audio_waveform, image_grid, generic_card.

top_level_directories.name: orchestrate
top_level_directories.notes: Plan compilation and test running: DSL, compile, test_runner, CLI. Top-level subsystem, not part of astrid/core.

top_level_directories.name: packs
top_level_directories.notes: Capability surface — every executor, orchestrator, and element ships in a pack under astrid/packs/<pack>/. The kernel (astrid/core/pack/) provides the framework; packs provide the capabilities. Contains 19 shipped pack directories plus internal _core/ (skill-only shell, no pack.yaml) and schemas/ (legacy reference only; canonical schemas moved to astrid/core/pack/schemas/v1/ in M2 T10). Top-level .py files (cli.py, validate.py, agent_index.py, gitignore.py, install.py, _canonical_entrypoint.py) are all thin compatibility re-export shims — their canonical implementations live in astrid/core/pack/. Enforced by _validate_packs_top_level_modules() in structure.py (added M2 T13). Detailed inventory in pack-layout-variants.json.

top_level_directories.name: skills
top_level_directories.notes: Agent skill discovery, registry, and harness runtimes (base, codex, claude, hermes).

top_level_directories.name: threads
top_level_directories.notes: Lineage and thread management. Thread index, ID generation (ULID), provenance tracking, record schema. The m5a milestone removed thread wrapper symbols from the public surface; only 10 lineage symbols remain in astrid.threads.__all__.

top_level_directories.name: timeline
top_level_directories.notes: Thin public re-export surface for the canonical core timeline API. Callers import from astrid.timeline while implementation lives in astrid.core.timeline. Guarded by _MILESTONE_COMPATIBILITY_SHIM_EXEMPTIONS with TODO(m5b) marker requirement. Removal deferred to M5b for broader Banodoco integration work.

top_level_directories.name: utilities
top_level_directories.notes: Generic helpers: LLM client construction, environment handling.

top_level_directories.name: verify
top_level_directories.notes: Verification helpers. Soft boundary — currently a convention, not a hard gate.

shim_locations.astrid/core/pack_machinery/: Thin re-export shims for cli, validate, agent_index, gitignore, install (plus deprecated schemas/ copy). Retained for M5; removal deferred to M6+.

m2_pack_machinery_layout.rule: New pack machinery belongs in astrid/core/pack/*. New internal code belongs in astrid/core/*. astrid/packs/ is for pack data (executors, orchestrators, elements, pack.yaml, skill/) — not for implementation.
